channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Shake Shack: Any Frozen Custard for $3 with Code CUSTARDTIME
item.guid: Shake Shack-Any Frozen Custard for $3 with Code CUST-2026-07-25
item.description: Order any frozen custard for just $3 at a kiosk, online, or in the Shake Shack app using code CUSTARDTIME through August 19. (Through August 19, 2026)

item.title: Krispy Kreme: Second Dozen Original Glazed Blueberry Doughnuts for $5
item.guid: Krispy Kreme-Second Dozen Original Glazed Blueberry D-2026-07-25
item.description: Buy any dozen or 16-count Minis at regular price and add a dozen Original Glazed Blueberry Flavored Doughnuts for $5 in-shop, drive-thru, or online with code BLUEBERRY. (Through July 26, 2026)

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu
item.description: Choose from 3-piece Signature Chicken, 3-piece Tenders, 8-piece Butterfly Shrimp, or a Chicken Sandwich for just $5; order in-store, online, or in-app. (Through August 31, 2026)

item.title: Popeyes: 12-Piece Wings or Tenders for $12
item.description: Get 12-piece bone-in or boneless wings or chicken tenders (3 flavors with sauces) for $12 via the Popeyes app or website. (Through July 26, 2026)

item.title: Burger King: $5 Your Way Meal Daily
item.guid: Burger King-$5 Your Way Meal Daily-2026-07-25
item.description: Build your own $5 meal in the app choosing from sandwiches like the Whopper Jr., plus fries and a drink at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: McDonald's: $5 Breakfast Meal Deal In-App
item.description: Get a Sausage McMuffin Meal or Sausage Biscuit Meal including sandwich, hash brown, and coffee for $5 exclusively through the McDonald's app. (Limited time)

item.title: Wendy's: Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger App Bundle
item.description: Get a Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger or Crispy Chicken BLT, 4-piece nuggets, junior fries, and a small drink bundled together at a value price in the Wendy's app. (Limited time)

item.title: Taco Bell: $5.99 Luxe Cravings Box
item.description: Order the Luxe Cravings Box for $5.99 in the Taco Bell app; includes a Chalupa Supreme, beefy 5-layer burrito, double-stacked taco, chips, nacho cheese sauce, and medium drink. (Limited time)

item.title: Pizza Hut: Any Pizza for $9.99 Including Parmesan Stuffed Crust
item.guid: Pizza Hut-Any Pizza for $9.99 Including Parmesan S-2026-07-25
item.description: Get any pizza for $9.99, now including Parmesan Stuffed Crust at no extra charge, when you order online or in-app. (Through July 26, 2026)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving the delivery fee on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed, open to everyone. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Sweetgreen: Alice Waters' Peach & Goat Cheese Salad
item.description: Limited-edition summer collab with chef Alice Waters - a seasonal peach & goat cheese salad available nationwide in-app and in stores, with 1% of proceeds donated to the Edible Schoolyard Project. (Through August 10, 2026)
